summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb but ships no orb YAML or declared main entry. Its package.json defines a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable (chmod 493), and invokes it against the shipped math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscated blob (shuffled string-array + decoder function, obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNN identifiers) and is the only meaningful code in the tarball. Because the payload is executed under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node, its behavior is opaque to normal Node-based inspection while still auto-executing on every `npm install`. The package name `native-frontend-orb` reorders the tokens of the legitimate CircleCI orb repository git@github.com:ornikar/orb-frontend-native.git referenced in its own package.json — a typosquat of that publisher. A CircleCI orb has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate runtime or execute an obfuscated blob at install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
